solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/smallest-subsequence-of-distinct-characters/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1081. Smallest Subsequence of Distinct Characters

Given a string s, return the lexicographically smallest subsequence of s that contains all the distinct characters of s exactly once.

Example 1:

Input: s = "bcabc"
Output: "abc"

Example 2:

Input: s = "cbacdcbc"
Output: "acdb"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 1000
    s consists of lowercase English letters.

Note: This question is the same as 316: https://leetcode.com/problems/remove-duplicate-letters/
"""


class Solution:
    def smallestSubsequence(self, s: str) -> str:
        last_occurrence = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(s)}
        stack = []
        seen = set()

        for i, c in enumerate(s):
            if c not in seen:
                while stack and stack[-1] > c and last_occurrence[stack[-1]] > i:
                    removed = stack.pop()
                    seen.remove(removed)
                stack.append(c)
                seen.add(c)
        return "".join(stack)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.smallestSubsequence("bcabc"))  # "abc"

assert sol.smallestSubsequence("bcabc") == "abc"
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("cbacdcbc") == "acdb"

assert sol.smallestSubsequence("a") == "a"
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("aaaaaa") == "a"
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba")
    == "zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
)
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc") == "abc"
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("thequickbrownfoxjumpsoverthelazydog")
    == "eqickbownfxjumpsvrthlazydg"
)
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb") == "b"
)
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("abacb") == "abc"
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("zazbzazbzazbzazb") == "abz"
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" * 38)
    == "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
)
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("cbaabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc")
    == "abc"
)
assert (
    sol.smallestSubsequence("edcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcbaedcba")
    == "abcde"
)
assert sol.smallestSubsequence("a" * 999 + "b") == "ab"
